summary: An older homeowner talks about the property tax as a threat to the home she built, not as a policy.
realLife: Older residents talked about rising property tax in personal terms: the home was her studio and her yard her art, and the bill had roughly doubled. Her savings covered the payments for a while, but she did not know what came after. An advocate talked of fixed income and aging in place and of a state homestead exemption as a remedy.
sources: https://www.wvxu.org/local-news/2024-04-15/cincinnati-seniors-property-tax-increases (public radio story on seniors and property tax)
